name: Kasol Manali Group Trip
description: Explore the peaceful vibes of Kasol and Parvati Valley, visit Manikaran Gurudwara, and experience adventure activities in Kullu and Manali. Designed for young travelers and groups.
route: Chandigarh → Kasol → Manali → Solang Valley → Sissu → Chandigarh

itinerary.title: Departure (Train Journey)
itinerary.desc: Board train for Chandigarh and enjoy overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Transfer to Kasol
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Chandigarh. Drive to Kasol. Check-in and relax.

itinerary.title: Kasol Exploration & Manikaran
itinerary.desc: Visit Manikaran Gurudwara, Kasol Market, and riverside cafes.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Manali (Adventure Day)
itinerary.desc: Travel to Manali. En route river rafting in Beas River. Arrival in Manali and check-in.

itinerary.title: Sissu & Solang Valley
itinerary.desc: Drive through Atal Tunnel to Sissu. Explore Solang Valley.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Temple, Mall Road, and Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Return to Chandigarh
itinerary.desc: Morning departure to Chandigarh and board train back.

details: Comfortable standard stays in Kasol & Manali

luxury.label: Luxury
